name: NexusVIP
author: CS2Nexus
description: Per-server Normal VIP (Bronze..Platinum). Admin commands (!addvip, !vip) live in ServerCommands and are permission-gated there (owners bypass); this plugin keeps the VIP store, the css_addvip_as console bridge and the self-service commands (!vipinfo, !vipmenu).

commands.name: vipinfo
commands.description: Show your own VIP level and expiry.

commands.name: vipmenu
commands.description: Show all VIP features and which ones you have.
